node: Vertical AI workflow automation, proprietary data platforms, and regulated deployment software
summary: Layer 1B expansion found one high-attention reference anchor and three less-obvious US-listed workflow/data vendors tied to regulated or high-friction AI deployment. The strongest underfollowed fits are CCC Intelligent Solutions in insurance claims workflow automation and Doximity in physician workflow AI. FiscalNote is included only as a speculative micro-cap shadow candidate because its policy/regulatory data + MCP/API positioning is highly relevant to AI agents, but ARR contraction, execution issues, and very small market cap make it a later-layer risk screen priority rather than a clean candidate.
